title: Choose the visual direction for Ledger's landing page
question: The roll assigned Pneumatic Tube Exchange. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pneumatic Tube Exchange
options.lineage: Victorian pneumatic dispatch networks — pressurized capsules shooting through brass tubes between stations
options.thesis: The transfer is a physical capsule you can watch travel — the tube network makes encryption tangible as sealed brass, and arrival feels like a delivered object.
options.viewport: A dark field bisected by a luminous brass tube carrying a sealed capsule from a phone silhouette to a desktop silhouette — the capsule glows with the session code etched on it, pressure gauges flanking the CTA.
options.risk: Steampunk associations if the brass reads ornamental rather than industrial.

options.label: Signal Beam Relay
options.lineage: Deep-space communication arrays — focused signal beams crossing void between relay stations
options.thesis: Data is a visible beam of light connecting two endpoints across dark space — the void makes the encryption palpable (nothing else exists to intercept), and the beam's coherence dramatizes speed.
options.viewport: An SVG beam of structured light connecting a phone node and a desktop node across a dark field — the beam carries visible encrypted packets, the session code pulses at the midpoint relay, and the CTA sits where the beam lands.
options.risk: Reads generic sci-fi if the beam is just a gradient line instead of structured signal with visible data.

options.label: Locksmith's Workbench
options.lineage: Master locksmith workshops — precision key-cutting, tumbler mechanisms, vault engineering
options.thesis: The session code is a key being cut to fit one lock — encryption visualized as physical security engineering, each transfer a lock turned and opened.
options.viewport: A dark workbench where the session code renders as a key being precision-cut from hex digits — the phone and desktop are the lock and door, the key turns in an animated tumbler mechanism at the center.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the session code as a key is a direct metaphor; loses narrowly on speed — locksmiths imply patience, not 5-second transfers.
options.risk: Over-literal key metaphor becomes clip-art if the mechanisms aren't rendered with real engineering detail.

options.label: Particle Accelerator Tunnel
options.lineage: CERN-style particle collider tunnels — data as high-energy particles in a controlled beam
options.case: Fuses poorly: colliders destroy on impact, the opposite of delivering intact data.
options.kept: Tunnel perspective and scale of engineering commitment.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean dark SaaS landing page — gradient hero, feature grid, the arrangement every transfer tool ships.
canonCard.viewport: Dark gradient hero with headline left, device mockup right, three-column feature grid below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Pushbullet, Snapdrop, or any file-sharing tool by design.
